definitions.explanation: The practice of interpreting the positions and movements of celestial bodies to predict events and understand personality traits. Distinct from astronomy, which is a natural science.

examples.japanese: {占星術|せんせいじゅつ}に{興味|きょうみ}がある。
{占星術|せんせいじゅつ}では{星|ほし}の{配置|はいち}から{運勢|うんせい}を{読|よ}む。
examples.english: In astrology, one reads fortunes from the arrangement of the stars.

examples.japanese: {西洋|せいよう}{占星術|せんせいじゅつ}では{十二|じゅうに}の{星座|せいざ}に{基|もと}づいて{性格|せいかく}を{分析|ぶんせき}する。
examples.english: In Western astrology, personality is analyzed based on twelve zodiac signs.

notes:
Composed of {占|せん} (divination), {星|せい} (star), and {術|じゅつ} (art, technique).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {西洋|せいよう}{占星術|せんせいじゅつ} (Western astrology)
- {占星術|せんせいじゅつ}のホロスコープ (astrological horoscope)
- {占星術|せんせいじゅつ}{師|し} (astrologer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {占星術|せんせいじゅつ}: astrology (divination based on celestial bodies)
- {天文学|てんもんがく}: astronomy (the scientific study of celestial objects)
- {星占|ほしうらな}い: horoscope, star divination (more casual)
